components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #e0c985; color: #251818; font-family: 'Kanit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(197,160,89,0.4); transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ebd9a2; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(197,160,89,0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0c985; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(197,160,89,0.3); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary CTA. Transparent with gold outline.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost">ดูบริการทั้งหมด</button>

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Floating interactive card. Glass treatment — purposeful, not decorative.
components.html:
วางแผนเกษียณ

สร้างแผนการเงินที่มั่นคงสำหรับอนาคตของคุณ ด้วยกลยุทธ์ที่ปรับให้เหมาะกับเป้าหมายส่วนตัว
components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: rgba(74,58,58,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card-glass:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Kanit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #faf9f9; margin: 0 0 12px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Kanit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; color: #baabab; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Fixed glass navigation. Gold underline for active state.
components.html: หน้าแรกบริการบทความ
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; background: rgba(53,39,39,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding: 16px 32px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Kanit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #baabab; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 2px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #e0c985; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #e0c985; border-bottom-color: #e0c985; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0c985; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form input. Gold focus ring, no background color change.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Kanit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #faf9f9; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Kanit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; color: #faf9f9; background: #4a3a3a; border: 1px solid #5b4848; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a6868; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #e0c985; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(224,201,133,0.3); }

narrative.overview:
CCPun's visual language is built on one premise: a person of genuine expertise handing you a precision instrument — something that orients, clarifies, and earns trust through quality alone. The dark warm-charcoal surfaces create an intimate atmosphere, while the muted gold speaks of accumulated value rather than performative wealth.

The system is deliberately warm without being casual. Warmth is carried through temperature (the charcoal has a red-orange undertone, not cold grey), through typography (Kanit's humanist geometry reads Thai and Latin with equal dignity), and through controlled use of gold as a signal of care rather than luxury.

What this system explicitly rejects: the cold institutional aesthetic of Thai state banks, the amateur clip-art energy of generic insurance agent sites, and the untouchable distance of luxury lifestyle brands.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-warm, not dark-cold — charcoal surfaces carry red-orange undertone
Gold as signal of care, not of wealth
Glass reserved for interactive elevation, not decoration
Kanit for all type: Thai/Latin parity at one typeface weight range
Framer Motion for transitions that feel intentional, not reflexive

rules.name: The One Compass Rule
rules.body: Warm Gold appears on at most one primary CTA per viewport. It is a signal, not a decoration. If every button is gold, none of them are.

rules.name: The Temperature Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a neutral that trends toward cool grey or blue-grey. All neutrals must carry the red-orange hue of the charcoal base.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Kanit is the only typeface. Do not introduce a serif display face or a mono for code unless the UI genuinely requires it.

rules.name: The Purposeful Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass is reserved for the interactive layer that floats above content. Do not apply backdrop-filter to section backgrounds or decorative cards.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content sections and non-interactive containers carry no shadow. Depth is created through tonal layering, not shadows.

dos: Do use Warm Gold on at most one primary CTA per viewport.
Do apply text-wrap: balance to all headlines (h1–h3).
Do use the inset white highlight on every glass element.
Do apply Framer Motion ease-out easing (no bounce, no elastic) for all entrance animations.
Do add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives for every animation.
Do verify ink-muted (#baabab) passes 4.5:1 against Surface (#4a3a3a).
Do use Kanit 300 (light) for body copy.
donts: Don't apply glassmorphism to section backgrounds or decorative elements.
Don't make the interface look like a Thai state bank (cold neutrals, government blue).
Don't make it look like a generic Thai insurance agent site.
Don't make it look like a Bulgari-style luxury brand (untouchable, distant).
Don't use border-left as a colored accent stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't use all-caps Thai text at any size.
